newsitem.title: USA: EEOC says settles with Gruntal in harassment case.
newsitem.headline: EEOC says settles with Gruntal in harassment case.

text.p: The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission Inc said on Tuesday it reached a settlement with Gruntal & Co Inc in a sex harassment case.
The lawsuit was brought by six women who worked at the Wall Street firm.
The EEOC said Gruntal agreed to pay a $750,000 settlement to the six women.

The suit alleged that two managers at the Madison Avenue branch in New York engaged in repeated acts of sexual harassment. The EEOC alleged the acts included frequent remarks of a sexual nature, accompanied by sexual gestures; touching female employees in a sexual manner; and requesting that female employees engage in sexual activities.
The EEOC said in a statement that "Although Gruntal denied these charges, it signed a consent decree and entered into agreement with EEOC concluding the lawsuit."
